placements.title: Enforcing Verifiable Deployment Controls and Operational Gates
placements.frame: How does the organization structure, enforce, and maintain ownership over release verification gates and pipeline compliance across environments?

placements.title: Mandatory Signed Manifests Gate Meridian Deployments Against Unverified Artifacts
placements.frame: How do mandatory signed release manifests and verified gate enforcement prevent unverified artifacts from reaching staging and production?
placements.why: Captures the policy requiring cryptographically signed release manifests for all Meridian release train deployments across staging and production to prevent unsigned artifact escapes.
